edits.before: - Thresh Death Sentence: matchup-defining — The hook starts the lantern chain — dodge it and the playbook waits 19 seconds. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep Q Aqua Prison banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Thresh Death Sentence: matchup-defining — The hook starts the lantern chain; dodge it and the playbook waits 19 seconds. - Both sides carry a displacement (your Tidal Wave, his Death Sentence pull) — whoever lands theirs first owns the engage. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
